title: React API Fetcher
description: Fetch and display data from a public API using React hooks

steps.title: Setup Effect Hook
steps.description: Create an ApiFetcher component. Use React.useEffect to fetch data from https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users when the component mounts. Store the result in a users state array. Log the users to the console.
hints: The empty dependency array [] means it runs once on mount

verification.failureMessage: Make sure you fetch from the URL and log the result

steps.title: Display Users
steps.description: Render the list of users. Show each user's name in an <h3> and their email in a <p> tag.

verification.successMessage: Users render with names and emails!
verification.failureMessage: Display each user's name and email from the API

steps.title: Loading State
steps.description: Add a loading state. Show 'Loading...' while the fetch is in progress, then show the user list when complete.
hints: Set setLoading(false) in the .then() after setting users

verification.successMessage: Loading state works — users see feedback while fetching!
verification.failureMessage: Add a loading state that shows while data is being fetched

steps.title: Error Handling
steps.description: Add an error state. If the fetch fails, catch the error and display 'Failed to load users. Please try again.' instead of the list.

verification.successMessage: All three states handled: loading, success, and error!
verification.failureMessage: Add error state handling for when the fetch fails
